diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:resource.helm_release.karpenter already depends on :module.karpenter implicitly: its `values` block references module.karpenter.service_account, module.karpenter.queue_name, etc. The explicit `depends_on = [module.karpenter]` entry duplicates that dependency and can be dropped.

:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig has `depends_on = [module.eks]`, but its local-exec command already references module.eks.cluster_name (twice), which establishes the same ordering implicitly. The explicit depends_on is redundant.

:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class already references module.eks (cluster_primary_security_group_id / cluster_security_group_id) in its `triggers` map, so the explicit depends_on entry on :module.eks is redundant.

:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class already references module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn in its `triggers` map, so the explicit depends_on entry on :module.karpenter (repeated explicitly via module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn) is redundant.

:resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset deletes the `aws-node` VPC-CNI daemonset from kube-system, which removes pod networking for the cluster. It must run only after Calico has been installed (via the tigera-operator Installation applied by :resource.null_resource.create_calico_installation), otherwise pods lose connectivity. It currently depends only on :module.eks and :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig, so nothing orders it after the Calico installation and it can run in parallel with / before it.
